whenToUse: The top of an introduction page where mood matters, such as travel or campaigns.
Short text sits over a large picture.
In only one or two places on a page.
whenNotToUse: Screens centered on reading or tasks.
Several layers move far in different directions (it causes motion sickness).
Services used on many low-end devices.

alternatives.name: Scroll Reveal
alternatives.reason: Moving content only once as it appears.

alternatives.name: Hero Section
alternatives.reason: Emphasizing the first screen without motion.

accessibility: The background is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
With reduced motion, the background scrolls along at the same speed (WCAG 2.3.3).
The scroll area has a tabIndex and a name, so it can be scrolled with the keyboard.
Text sits in a white area that doesn't overlap the background, so contrast holds.
